issues.description: Visibility mismatch for helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal): the textual instructions explicitly require the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal) to be public for testing, but both the template and the provided solution declare it private. Additionally, the UML in the problem statement shows the method as private, creating a contradiction inside the problem description (UML vs. textual instruction). This inconsistency will confuse students about the expected visibility and may prevent test code from accessing the helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Decide on and document a single visibility for singFarmSongVerse(Animal). If tests require access, change the method declaration in the template and solution to public (public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and update the UML in problem_statement.md to reflect the method as public. Also ensure the template method signature includes the Animal parameter (not commented out).
